maps.points.blackwood.detail-10: The tile at (-13, -5) activates when the party or an enemy steps on it, or when an item or another object holds it down.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-11:
First Meeting with the Blackforest Witch
I've seen the Blackwoods' witch
maps.points.blackwood.detail-12: A woman stands beside the remains of a small fire, her cloak soaked from the mist.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-13: Step on the sensor at (-5, -20) (can also be pressed by objects), triggering the Blackwoods' broken house event. The slime in the house hasn't been defeated yet.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-3: Slime collapses into the mud, and a hard object slides out of its body.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-5: Cold mud presses against the soles of the boots.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-6: The tile at (-5, -20) activates when the party or an enemy steps on it, or when an item or another object holds it down.
maps.points.blackwood.detail-7: The slime in the house hasn't been defeated yet
maps.points.blackwood.detail-8: You discover the remains of a small hut swallowed by mud and roots.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue: A damp notebook falls among the ruins, most of it already digested.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-10: "You should not stay here long. They will come again. They always do."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-14: How can we help you? (once only)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-16: Event opening (I've seen the Blackwoods' witch, The guard at the exit is still alive)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-17: The woman watches the dark forest in silence. Somewhere far away, branches crack beneath heavy paws.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-18: "They are still hunting. They never tire."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-19: Event opening (I've seen the Blackwoods' witch, The guard at the exit has been defeated)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-2: The pale moonlight illuminated the tall black trees around. Branches intertwined at the treetops, and mist drifted gently between the tree roots.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-20: The woman rises the moment she sees you. For the first time since meeting her, there is something alive behind her eyes. Hope.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-21: "The watcher is dead... then the path is finally open."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-22: She looks toward the dark woods beyond the trees."Please. Help me leave this place before the others find us."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-23: Choose “Who are you?” (She asked for the first time who she was)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-24: She opens her mouth, but no answer comes.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-26: She presses trembling fingers against her forehead."I..."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-27: The distant howl of wolves rolls through the trees. She closes her eyes.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-28: "I remember blood. Prayers. Screaming. Then only the forest."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-3: Wolf howls come from the depths of darkness.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-33: Choose “Who are you?” (I've already asked who she is, The name of Evelyn has not yet been recovered)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-34: She remains silent for a long time.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-38: She searches the name in silence.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-39: "Tired hands. Pain in the joints. She hated bitter medicine. I used honey when I had it."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-4: Event opening (The slime in the house hasn't been defeated yet)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-42: A faint smile appears for only a moment."She never stopped talking long enough to rest."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-46: For a moment, she almost laughed.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-47: “She is always worried, Everything needs to be asked twice. I told her that the dosage was already low enough. I think… she should believe me.”
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-48: Her expression dimmed, as if she wasn’t sure what had happened later.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-5: As you step closer, the mud beneath the ruins begins to move.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-52: She slowly pronounced that name, as if to confirm whether it still belonged to her.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-53: “Yes, I think… yes, That is my name.”
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-54: Her fear eased for the first time; what replaced it might be sadness, or perhaps memories.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-55: Choose “Who are you?” (I've already asked who she is, The name of Evelyn was retrieved)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-59: “I remember the warm room. People smiled at me, Because they believed I could still help.”
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-6: The ground bulges, then bursts open as a mass of slime drags itself from the mud.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-61: She looks up at the black trees, their branches tangled beneath the pale moon.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-64: Her gaze slips past you, into the trees.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-65: "They were men once. I remember that much. Steel. Torches. Orders spoken like prayers."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-66: A distant howl rolls through the woods. She goes quiet until it fades.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-67: "Now they hunt. That is all this place allows them to do."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-69: She steps closer, careful, desperate, trying not to seem desperate.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-7: Event opening (First Meeting with the Blackforest Witch)
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-71: "If the wolves die, this place weakens. If this place weakens... perhaps death will finally remember me."
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-72: Far away, something howls. The woman flinches before the sound fully reaches you.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-74: You stepped back from the fire. The woman stared at the woods, listening for the sound of animal feet in the darkness.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-8: For a moment she simply watches you, tense like a wounded animal expecting another hunt to begin.
maps.points.blackwood.dialogue-9: Then distant howling echoes through the forest. Her expression changes instantly. Fear. Exhaustion.
